main.name: Sidharth Kamath
main.bio: I am driven by curiosity about how technology works beneath the surface. As an engineer, I am particularly interested in cybersecurity and system design — studying how complex systems fail, uncovering vulnerabilities, and building solutions that make them more secure and resilient. I enjoy collaborating with teams during hackathons, where rapid experimentation and problem-solving lead to practical systems. Beyond academics, I focus on discipline, consistency, and improving a little every day.
main.contactmessage: Let's build secure and innovative solutions together!

work.title: Intern --- Network & Security
work.description: Monitored 500+ daily security events across SIEM dashboards and correlated alerts with system logs for threat triage. Identified malware indicators and suspicious IP activity using traffic analysis. Reviewed firewall rules, ACL configurations, and endpoint security policies in collaboration with the SOC team. Analyzed EDR/XDR alerts and contributed to incident response documentation.

projects.title: MCEP --- Micro-Credential Examination Platform
projects.about: Developed an enterprise-grade credential platform supporting multi-role RBAC for students, institutes, employers, and administrators. Implemented secure authentication using Keycloak OAuth2/OIDC and credential verification via DigiLocker, blockchain validation, and manual review.

projects.title: AegisScan --- Autonomous Security Testing Framework
projects.about: Built an automated penetration testing framework orchestrating tools including Nmap, Nikto, SQLMap, DirB, WPScan, and SearchSploit. Implemented Docker-based container isolation with input validation and target whitelisting. Enabled LLM-assisted scan orchestration to dynamically select and sequence reconnaissance and vulnerability tests.
projects.tech: Python, Docker, Kali Linux, MCP Protocol

projects.title: hearMeOut --- AI-Assisted Student Wellness Platform
projects.about: Built a platform connecting students, counsellors, and administrators for mental health support and digital journaling. Integrated AI-based mood analysis using PHQ-9/GAD-7 assessments to assist early detection of mental health concerns. Implemented secure journaling, counsellor booking, and moderated anonymous discussion forums.

projects.title: LeetHelper --- VS Code Extension for LeetCode
projects.about: Built a VS Code extension enabling users to browse, solve, test, and submit LeetCode problems directly within the editor. Implemented LeetCode API integration with cookie-based session authentication and custom test case execution. Packaged and published the extension using vsce with daily challenge sync and multi-language support.
projects.tech: TypeScript, VS Code Extension API, Webpack
